reason: Conversation 1 never diagnoses anything: it asks the same 'what is it doing wrong' question three times, ignores the customer's clear answers that nothing fails and Cottons 40 is shorter, and leaves her with no idea whether to return the machine. Conversation 2 immediately and correctly reassures that Eco 40-60 is deliberately long and low-temperature, confirms normality once she reports Cottons 40 at ~2 hours and clean results, explicitly says not to send it back, and sensibly suggests standard programmes when speed matters. Its one weakness is an unnecessary unplug/seal check and a somewhat redundant 60°C test suggestion, but these are harmless and it correctly dropped them once the evidence pointed to normal behaviour.
